evidence.locator: Opening cinematic; account of the broken Elden Ring and the demigod war
evidence.summary_en: The opening connects the broken Elden Ring, the Great Runes, the demigods and the war called the Shattering.

evidence.locator: Opening cinematic; introduction of the Night of the Black Knives
evidence.summary_en: The opening identifies Godwyn as the first demigod to die during the Night of the Black Knives.

evidence.locator: Official website; base-game story synopsis
evidence.summary_en: The official synopsis describes Marika's rule, the Elden Ring, the Great Runes, the Shattering and the return of the Tarnished.

evidence.locator: Melina's recitations of Marika's words at the Third Church, Grand Lift and Queen's Bedchamber
evidence.summary_en: Marika's spoken echoes connect Godfrey's loss of grace, the exile of his warriors, their eventual return and her charge to Radagon.

evidence.locator: Leyndell statue revelation and Goldmask quest progression
evidence.summary_en: The capital's hidden revelation identifies Radagon and Marika as one being while the narrative continues to distinguish their actions and roles.

evidence.locator: Carian and Golden Order equipment, sorcery and incantation descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records describe the Liurnian conflicts, Radagon's union with Rennala and the Carian children later becoming demigod stepchildren.

evidence.locator: Remembrances of major demigods and shardbearers
evidence.summary_en: The remembrances identify key family relations and titles among Marika, Radagon, Godfrey and their demigod children.

evidence.locator: Black Knife, Cursemark of Death and Maliketh-related item descriptions
evidence.summary_en: These items connect the stolen fragment of Destined Death, the Black Knives, Ranni's ritual and Godwyn's death in soul.

evidence.locator: Great Rune descriptions obtained from shardbearers
evidence.summary_en: The Great Runes identify their bearers and preserve family and lineage details about the demigods.

evidence.locator: Caelid sword monument associated with the Battle of Aeonia
evidence.summary_en: The memorial places Malenia and Radahn in their decisive clash and associates it with the scarlet bloom.

evidence.locator: Sword monuments around Altus Plateau and Leyndell
evidence.summary_en: The monuments record attacks on the capital and its successful defense during the Shattering.

evidence.locator: Haligtree, unalloyed gold and Miquella-related item descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records connect Miquella, Malenia, unalloyed gold and the growth of the Haligtree.

evidence.locator: Gideon's report about Mohg, Miquella and the cocoon
evidence.summary_en: Gideon's investigation connects Mohg with Miquella's removal from the Haligtree and the cocoon at Mohgwyn Palace.

evidence.locator: Mohg encounter and Miquella's cocoon at Mohgwyn Palace
evidence.summary_en: The encounter presents Mohg beside the cocoon containing Miquella's body.

evidence.locator: Map fragments and regional item descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Map and item records situate major powers in Leyndell, Liurnia, Caelid, Volcano Manor, the Haligtree and Mohgwyn Palace.

evidence.locator: Official expansion page; story premise
evidence.summary_en: The official premise places Miquella's journey, Marika's first arrival and Messmer's purge in the Realm of Shadow.

evidence.locator: Official guide; access requirements and entry sequence
evidence.summary_en: The official guide links Mohg's defeat, Miquella's cocoon and the player's passage into the Realm of Shadow, with Radahn's defeat also required.

evidence.locator: Shadow of the Erdtree story trailer; account of the hidden war
evidence.summary_en: The trailer depicts an old conflict in the Realm of Shadow led by Messmer and frames it as concealed from the later world.

evidence.locator: Remembrance of the Impaler and related Messmer item descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records identify Messmer's connection to Marika and his role in the crusade against the hornsent.

evidence.locator: Miquella's Crosses and follower dialogue across the Realm of Shadow
evidence.summary_en: The crosses and dialogue trace Miquella's progressive abandonment of body, lineage and Golden inheritance.

evidence.locator: Official overview of Miquella's followers
evidence.summary_en: The official overview identifies Miquella as a child of Marika and Radagon and describes the followers drawn to his path.

evidence.locator: Sir Ansbach quest dialogue
evidence.summary_en: Ansbach's investigation addresses Mohg, Miquella's influence and the purpose of Miquella's journey.

evidence.locator: Realm of Shadow map fragments and regional item descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Regional records situate Belurat, Enir-Ilim and the hornsent civilization within the concealed realm.

evidence.locator: Frenzied Flame incantations, notes, and related quest records
evidence.summary_en: Records connect the Frenzied Flame, the Three Fingers, madness and an ambition to erase distinctions by returning existence to one.

evidence.locator: Melina's early meetings, accord and guidance dialogue
evidence.summary_en: Melina offers an accord to the Tarnished and guides their journey toward the Erdtree while pursuing her own purpose.

evidence.locator: Ranni quest meetings at Caria Manor, Siofra and Nokron
evidence.summary_en: Ranni's quest identifies Blaidd, Iji and Seluvis as members of her retinue and traces their roles in her search for Nokron and the Fingerslayer Blade.

evidence.locator: Godrick remembrance, Stormveil scenes and related descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records identify Godrick as a distant member of the Golden Lineage who rules from Stormveil and practices grafting.

evidence.locator: Fire Giant remembrance, Flame of the Fell God and Forge descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records connect the last Fire Giant, the Mountaintops, the Forge and the enduring flame once opposed by Marika's forces.

evidence.locator: Fia quest, Deeproot Depths scenes and Fortissax remembrance
evidence.summary_en: Fia's quest connects her to Godwyn, Those Who Live in Death and Fortissax, who fought Death within his companion.

evidence.locator: Volcano Manor invitations, Tanith dialogue and Rykard encounter
evidence.summary_en: Volcano Manor records identify Tanith as its proprietress and the faction as a movement serving Rykard in rebellion against the Erdtree.

evidence.locator: Roundtable Hold introductions and Gideon's demigod briefings
evidence.summary_en: Gideon's dialogue establishes him as the All-Knowing leader associated with Roundtable Hold and its search for Great Runes.

evidence.locator: Mohg remembrance and blood incantation descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Blood-related records identify the Formless Mother as the power encountered and served by Mohg.

evidence.locator: Lake of Rot, rot incantations, needles and Malenia-related descriptions
evidence.summary_en: These records connect Scarlet Rot to Malenia, Caelid, the Lake of Rot and efforts to resist an outer power's influence.

evidence.locator: Deathroot, Black Knife and Death-related item descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Deathroot spread through roots beneath the Lands Between after Death entered Godwyn and became associated with Those Who Live in Death.

evidence.locator: Nox, Eternal City, Siofra and Fingerslayer Blade descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Subterranean records place Nokron by the Siofra and connect the Nox with an artificial night and opposition to the Greater Will.

evidence.locator: Dragonlord remembrance and Farum Azula-related descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records identify Placidusax as an Elden Lord from an age before the Erdtree and place him in Farum Azula beyond ordinary time.

evidence.locator: Metyr remembrance, finger ruins and Ymir quest records
evidence.summary_en: The records identify Metyr as mother of the Fingers, a daughter of the Greater Will, and the first shooting star to reach the Lands Between.

evidence.locator: Stone Coffin Fissure, Thiollier dialogue and St. Trina quest scenes
evidence.summary_en: The quest records connect St. Trina to Miquella's discarded aspect, sleep, Thiollier and opposition to Miquella's godhood.

evidence.locator: Abyssal Woods, Midra's Manse and frenzy-related descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Regional records connect Midra, the Abyssal Woods, prolonged torment and the emergence of a Lord of Frenzied Flame.

evidence.locator: Bayle remembrance, Dragon Communion and Jagged Peak records
evidence.summary_en: Dragon records describe Bayle's ancient conflict with Placidusax and the enduring wounds borne by both dragons.

evidence.locator: Rellana remembrance and Twin Moon Knight equipment descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records identify Rellana as Rennala's younger twin, a Carian princess who relinquished her birthright and followed Messmer into the Realm of Shadow.

evidence.locator: Albus and Latenna quest dialogue in Liurnia and the Consecrated Snowfield
evidence.summary_en: The quest identifies Albus and Latenna as Albinaurics, connects the secret medallion to the Haligtree route, and traces Latenna's search for the Albinaurics' promised refuge.

evidence.locator: Godskin armor, Black Flame incantations, Godslayer's Greatsword and related descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records connect the Godskin Apostles to the Gloam-Eyed Queen, Destined Death and a god-slaying black flame whose true power diminished after the Rune of Death was sealed.

evidence.locator: Numen character origin, Numen's Rune, Marika's Hammer and Black Knife armor descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records identify Marika with the long-lived Numen people and describe the Black Knife assassins as women rumored to be Numen with close ties to her.

evidence.locator: Bolt of Gransax, Lansseax's Glaive, dragon cult incantations and Greyoll's Roar descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Dragon records connect Gransax's attack on Leyndell to the ancient dragon war, identify Lansseax as Fortissax's sister and a priestess of the dragon cult, and call Greyoll the mother of all dragons.

evidence.locator: Siluria's Tree, Crucible armor and Aspect of the Crucible descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Crucible records identify it as the primordial form of the Erdtree, where life was once blended together, and connect its knights to Godfrey.

evidence.locator: Enia dialogue concerning the Rune of Death and the Golden Order
evidence.summary_en: Enia's account connects the founding of the Golden Order to the removal and sealing of Destined Death.

evidence.locator: Morgott's and Mohg's Great Runes, Regal Omen Bairn and Omen descriptions
evidence.summary_en: The records identify Morgott and Mohg as Omen twins of the Golden Lineage and describe royal Omens as confined beneath the capital rather than excised.

evidence.locator: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, Cathedral of the Forsaken and Three Fingers encounter
evidence.summary_en: The underground route beneath Leyndell leads through the Omen prison, past Mohg's apparition, to the sealed chamber of the Three Fingers.

evidence.locator: Opening cinematic and Sites of Grace guidance
evidence.summary_en: The opening calls the exiled dead back as Tarnished, while visible grace guides their journey toward the Elden Ring and the office of Elden Lord.

evidence.locator: Remembrance of Hoarah Loux, Elden Lord armor and Godfrey encounter
evidence.summary_en: Godfrey was the first Elden Lord; after losing grace he became the first Tarnished and led his warriors away from the Lands Between.

evidence.locator: Descriptions of the three Mending Runes and their ending choices
evidence.summary_en: Fia, Goldmask and the Dung Eater each produce a distinct Mending Rune that can repair the Elden Ring and establish a corresponding order.

evidence.locator: Hyetta quest dialogue and Three Fingers audience beneath Leyndell
evidence.summary_en: Hyetta follows the distant light to the Three Fingers, interprets their purpose and offers to serve the prospective Lord of Frenzied Flame as maiden.

evidence.locator: Shabriri dialogue at the Zamor Ruins and Frenzied Flame ending route
evidence.summary_en: Shabriri urges the Tarnished to inherit the Frenzied Flame below Leyndell in order to spare Melina from serving as kindling.

evidence.locator: Millicent and Gowry quest dialogue; Unalloyed Gold Needle and prosthesis records
evidence.summary_en: Millicent's journey links her to Gowry, the scarlet rot, Malenia and the unalloyed gold needle, culminating at the Haligtree.

evidence.locator: Corhyn and Goldmask quest dialogue; Mending Rune of Perfect Order
evidence.summary_en: Corhyn leaves Roundtable Hold to follow Goldmask, whose study of the Golden Order culminates in the Mending Rune of Perfect Order.

evidence.locator: Rogier dialogue, Black Knifeprint investigation and Stormveil bloodstain
evidence.summary_en: Rogier investigates the Night of the Black Knives and seeks the knifeprint that records the ritual behind Godwyn's death.

evidence.locator: D and Fia quest dialogue, Weathered Dagger and Twinned armor scenes
evidence.summary_en: D hunts Those Who Live in Death, while Fia champions them; their opposed paths meet through the returned dagger at Roundtable Hold.

evidence.locator: Alexander quest dialogue from Limgrave through Farum Azula; Shard of Alexander
evidence.summary_en: Alexander is a warrior jar who joins the Radahn Festival, pursues strength and ultimately challenges the Tarnished in Farum Azula.

evidence.locator: Roderika and Hewg dialogue at Stormhill Shack and Roundtable Hold
evidence.summary_en: Roderika survives her companions, reaches Roundtable Hold and discovers a talent for spirit tuning under Hewg's guidance.

evidence.locator: Nepheli, Kenneth and Gostoc dialogue through the Stormveil throne-room conclusion
evidence.summary_en: Nepheli opposes Godrick, receives the Stormhawk King's ashes and is recognized by Kenneth Haight as the new ruler of Limgrave, with Gostoc in attendance.

evidence.locator: Boc quest dialogue from Limgrave through Leyndell and tailoring service
evidence.summary_en: Boc is a demi-human seamster rescued by the Tarnished who follows their route and offers garment alteration.

evidence.locator: Sellen and Jerren quest dialogue, Primal Glintstone transfer and Academy confrontation
evidence.summary_en: The exiled sorcerer Sellen preserves herself in a primal glintstone and returns to Raya Lucaria, while the witch-hunter Jerren pursues and opposes her.

evidence.locator: Diallos dialogue at Roundtable Hold, Liurnia, Volcano Manor and Jarburg
evidence.summary_en: Diallos leaves the Roundtable, briefly joins Volcano Manor and later becomes potentate of Jarburg, where he dies defending the jars.

evidence.locator: Thops dialogue, second Academy Glintstone Key and Schoolhouse Classroom conclusion
evidence.summary_en: Thops, an expelled Academy student, seeks a spare glintstone key and returns to Raya Lucaria after receiving one.

evidence.locator: Yura's Bloody Finger hunts and Eleonora encounter at the Second Church of Marika
evidence.summary_en: Yura hunts Bloody Fingers across the Lands Between and pursues Eleonora, who ultimately kills him before confronting the Tarnished.

evidence.locator: Redmane, Cleanrot, Cuckoo and Blackflame Monk armor and weapon descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Military records connect the Redmanes to Radahn, the Cleanrot Knights to Malenia, the Cuckoo knights to Liurnia's Academy forces and the Blackflame Monks to the god-slaying flame.

evidence.locator: World map regions, map fragments and regional encounters
evidence.summary_en: The journey places Stormveil and Fort Haight in Limgrave, the Weeping Peninsula south of Limgrave, Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir and Leyndell on the Altus Plateau.

evidence.locator: Death's Poker, Death Ritual Spear, Explosive Ghostflame and Twinbird Kite Shield descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Deathbirds served as keepers of the dead before the Erdtree, tending ghostflame; their mother is the Twinbird, described as an envoy of an outer god.

evidence.locator: Ancestral Follower armor, horn charms and Ancestral Spirit remembrance
evidence.summary_en: Ancestral Followers reject metal and artificial refinement, worship horned ancestral life and inhabit the underground river regions.

evidence.locator: Veteran's Prosthesis, Commander's Standard and Haligtree Secret Medallion descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Commander O'Neil remains in rot-stricken Caelid, while Commander Niall guards Castle Sol and the left half of the Haligtree medallion.

evidence.locator: Fallingstar Beast Jaw, Gravity Stone and Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast records
evidence.summary_en: Fallingstar Beasts are stone-skinned creatures associated with meteor impacts and gravity power, encountered in mining regions and on Mt. Gelmir.

evidence.locator: Minor Erdtree, Tooth Whip, Innard Meat and Shaman Village records
evidence.summary_en: The records place Marika among the shamans of the Hinterland and document the hornsent practice of cutting and melding shaman flesh in ritual jars.

evidence.locator: Messmer remembrance, armor, Black Knight and Fire Knight descriptions
evidence.summary_en: Marika's son Messmer led the crusade against the hornsent from Shadow Keep with Black Knights, Fire Knights and his flame, then remained abandoned in the hidden realm.

evidence.locator: Miquella's thirteen crosses and St. Trina revelation
evidence.summary_en: Miquella's crosses trace his abandonment of flesh, lineage, fear, doubt and love throughout the Realm of Shadow; his discarded love took the form of St. Trina.

evidence.locator: Promised Consort remembrance, Secret Rite Scroll, Ansbach and Freyja dialogue, final memory
evidence.summary_en: Miquella's plan uses Mohg's body as a vessel to restore Radahn as his promised consort before Miquella emerges as a god at the Gate of Divinity.

evidence.locator: Ymir quest dialogue, ruin maps and three hanging-bell encounters
evidence.summary_en: Ymir sends the Tarnished through Rhia and Dheo to Miyr beneath his cathedral, reveals the Fingers' defective origin and attempts to replace Metyr as their mother.

evidence.locator: Ymir quest, Swordhand invasions and Jolán/Anna spirit-ash conclusion
evidence.summary_en: Jolán serves Ymir as a Swordhand of Night; her sister Anna guards the route to Metyr and the sisters can ultimately be united as spirit ashes.

evidence.locator: Igon dialogue and summon during the ascent of Jagged Peak
evidence.summary_en: Bayle broke Igon's body and spirit, but Igon continues the hunt and asks the Tarnished to summon him for revenge against the dread dragon.

evidence.locator: Florissax dialogue, Priestess Heart and Dragon Communion records
evidence.summary_en: Florissax serves Placidusax at the Grand Altar and recruits mortal drake warriors into the ancient hunt for Bayle and his descendants.

evidence.locator: Stone Coffin Fissure, St. Trina dialogue and Remembrance of Putrescence
evidence.summary_en: Discarded Trina lies in the fissure; putrescence from ancient coffins imbibed her nectar and became the knight that guards her garden.

evidence.locator: Follower dialogue before and after Miquella's charm breaks; Enir-Ilim confrontation
evidence.summary_en: After Miquella's charm breaks, Leda hunts perceived threats while Ansbach opposes Miquella's use of Mohg, Freyja accepts Radahn's return, and Dane remains loyal to Leda.

evidence.locator: Realm of Shadow map fragments and regional records
evidence.summary_en: The map places Gravesite Plain, Scadu Altus, the Rauh ruins, Cerulean Coast, Stone Coffin Fissure and Shadow Keep within the Realm of Shadow.

evidence.locator: Remembrances of the Saint of the Bud, Wild Boar Rider and Dancing Lion
evidence.summary_en: Romina embraced scarlet rot after her church burned, Gaius commanded Messmer's forces from Shadow Keep, and the hornsent's sculpted keepers invoked divine beasts for war.

localized_texts.text: La introducción relaciona el Círculo de Elden roto, las Grandes Runas, los semidioses y la guerra conocida como la Fragmentación.
Los registros vinculan la Llama Frenética, los Tres Dedos, la locura y el propósito de borrar las distinciones devolviendo la existencia a una sola unidad.
Melina ofrece un acuerdo al Sinluz y guía su viaje hacia el Árbol Áureo mientras persigue su propio propósito.
La misión de Ranni identifica a Blaidd, Iji y Seluvis como miembros de su séquito y describe sus papeles en la búsqueda de Nokron y la Hoja Dactilocida.
A missão de Ranni identifica Blaidd, Iji e Seluvis como membros de seu séquito e descreve seus papéis na busca por Nokron e pela Lâmina Matadora de Dedos.
Los registros identifican a Godrick como miembro distante del Linaje Dorado, gobernante de Velo Tormentoso y practicante de injertos.
Os registros identificam Godrick como membro distante da Linhagem Dourada, governante do Castelo Tempesvéu e praticante de enxertos.
Los registros conectan al último Gigante de Fuego, las Cimas, la Forja y la llama perdurable combatida por las fuerzas de Marika.
Os registros relacionam o último Gigante de Fogo, os Picos, a Forja e a chama duradoura combatida pelas forças de Marika.
La misión de Fia la relaciona con Godwyn, Quienes Viven en la Muerte y Fortissax, que luchó contra la Muerte dentro de su compañero.
A missão de Fia a relaciona a Godwyn, aos Que Vivem na Morte e a Fortissax, que combateu a Morte dentro de seu companheiro.
Los registros identifican a Tanith como propietaria de la Mansión del Volcán y a la facción como servidora de Rykard en rebelión contra el Árbol Áureo.
Os registros identificam Tanith como proprietária da Mansão Vulcânica e a facção como servidora de Rykard em rebelião contra a Térvore.
Melina oferece um acordo ao Maculado e orienta sua jornada até a Térvore enquanto busca seu próprio propósito.
El diálogo de Gideon lo establece como líder Omnisciente asociado a la Mesa Redonda y a su búsqueda de Grandes Runas.
O diálogo de Gideon o estabelece como líder Onisciente associado à Mesa-Redonda e à busca por Grandes Runas.
Os registros relacionam a Chama Frenética, os Três Dedos, a loucura e o propósito de apagar distinções devolvendo a existência a uma única unidade.
Los registros de sangre identifican a la Madre Informe como el poder encontrado y servido por Mohg.
Os registros de sangue identificam a Mãe Sem Forma como o poder encontrado e servido por Mohg.
Los registros conectan la Putrefacción Escarlata con Malenia, Caelid, el Lago de la Putrefacción y los esfuerzos por resistir la influencia de un poder exterior.
Os registros relacionam a Podridão Escarlate a Malenia, Caelid, o Lago da Podridão e tentativas de resistir à influência de um poder exterior.
La Raíz Mortífera se extendió bajo las Tierras Intermedias después de que la Muerte entrara en Godwyn y quedó asociada con Quienes Viven en la Muerte.
A Raiz da Morte espalhou-se sob as Terras Intermédias depois que a Morte entrou em Godwyn e passou a ser associada aos Que Vivem na Morte.
Los registros subterráneos sitúan Nokron junto al Siofra y relacionan a los Nox con una noche artificial y la oposición a la Voluntad Mayor.
Os registros subterrâneos situam Nokron junto ao Siofra e relacionam os Nox a uma noite artificial e à oposição à Vontade Maior.
Los registros identifican a Placidusax como Señor de Elden de una era anterior al Árbol Áureo y lo sitúan en Farum Azula fuera del tiempo ordinario.
Os registros identificam Placidusax como Lorde Prístino de uma era anterior à Térvore e o situam em Farum Azula além do tempo comum.
Los registros identifican a Metyr como madre de los Dedos, hija de la Voluntad Mayor y primera estrella fugaz en llegar a las Tierras Intermedias.
Os registros identificam Metyr como mãe dos Dedos, filha da Vontade Maior e primeira estrela cadente a alcançar as Terras Intermédias.
Los registros relacionan a Santa Trina con el aspecto abandonado de Miquella, el sueño, Thiollier y la oposición a la divinidad de Miquella.
Os registros relacionam Santa Trina ao aspecto abandonado de Miquella, ao sono, a Thiollier e à oposição à divindade de Miquella.
Los registros regionales relacionan a Midra, los Bosques Abisales, un tormento prolongado y el surgimiento de un Señor de la Llama Frenética.
Os registros regionais relacionam Midra, os Bosques Abissais, um tormento prolongado e o surgimento de um Lorde da Chama Frenética.
Los registros dracónicos describen el antiguo conflicto de Bayle con Placidusax y las heridas duraderas sufridas por ambos dragones.
Os registros dracônicos descrevem o antigo conflito de Bayle com Placidusax e as feridas duradouras sofridas por ambos os dragões.
A abertura relaciona o Círculo Prístino quebrado, as Grandes Runas, os semideuses e a guerra conhecida como a Fragmentação.
La introducción identifica a Godwyn como el primer semidiós que murió durante la Noche de los Cuchillos Negros.
A abertura identifica Godwyn como o primeiro semideus a morrer durante a Noite das Facas Negras.
La sinopsis oficial describe el reinado de Marika, el Círculo de Elden, las Grandes Runas, la Fragmentación y el regreso de los Sinluz.
A sinopse oficial descreve o governo de Marika, o Círculo Prístino, as Grandes Runas, a Fragmentação e o retorno dos Maculados.
Los ecos de las palabras de Marika relacionan la pérdida de gracia de Godfrey, el exilio de sus guerreros, su futuro regreso y la orden dada a Radagon.
Os ecos das palavras de Marika relacionam a perda da graça de Godfrey, o exílio de seus guerreiros, o futuro retorno deles e a ordem dada a Radagon.
La revelación oculta de la capital identifica a Radagon y Marika como un mismo ser, aunque la narrativa sigue distinguiendo sus acciones y funciones.
A revelação oculta da capital identifica Radagon e Marika como um mesmo ser, embora a narrativa continue distinguindo suas ações e funções.
Los registros describen los conflictos de Liurnia, la unión de Radagon con Rennala y cómo los hijos carianos se convirtieron después en hijastros semidioses.
Os registros descrevem os conflitos de Liurnia, a união de Radagon com Rennala e como os filhos carianos depois se tornaram enteados semideuses.
Los recuerdos identifican relaciones familiares y títulos importantes entre Marika, Radagon, Godfrey y sus hijos semidioses.
As lembranças identificam relações familiares e títulos importantes entre Marika, Radagon, Godfrey e seus filhos semideuses.
Estos objetos relacionan el fragmento robado de la Muerte Destinada, los Cuchillos Negros, el ritual de Ranni y la muerte del alma de Godwyn.
Esses itens relacionam o fragmento roubado da Morte Destinada, as Facas Negras, o ritual de Ranni e a morte da alma de Godwyn.
Las Grandes Runas identifican a sus portadores y conservan detalles familiares y de linaje sobre los semidioses.
As Grandes Runas identificam seus portadores e preservam detalhes familiares e de linhagem sobre os semideuses.
El monumento sitúa a Malenia y Radahn en su enfrentamiento decisivo y lo relaciona con la floración escarlata.
O monumento situa Malenia e Radahn em seu confronto decisivo e o relaciona ao florescimento escarlate.
Los monumentos registran ataques contra la capital y su defensa exitosa durante la Fragmentación.
Os monumentos registram ataques contra a capital e sua defesa bem-sucedida durante a Fragmentação.
Los registros relacionan a Miquella, Malenia, el oro puro y el crecimiento del Árbol Hierático.
Os registros relacionam Miquella, Malenia, o ouro puro e o crescimento da Árvore Sacra.
La investigación de Gideon relaciona a Mohg con la retirada de Miquella del Árbol Hierático y con el capullo del Palacio de Mohgwyn.
A investigação de Gideon relaciona Mohg à retirada de Miquella da Árvore Sacra e ao casulo no Palácio de Mohgwyn.
El encuentro muestra a Mohg junto al capullo que contiene el cuerpo de Miquella.
O encontro mostra Mohg ao lado do casulo que contém o corpo de Miquella.
Los mapas y objetos sitúan a las principales potencias en Leyndell, Liurnia, Caelid, la Mansión del Volcán, el Árbol Hierático y el Palacio de Mohgwyn.
Mapas e itens situam as principais potências em Leyndell, Liurnia, Caelid, Mansão Vulcânica, Árvore Sacra e Palácio de Mohgwyn.
La premisa oficial sitúa el viaje de Miquella, la primera llegada de Marika y la purga de Messmer en el Reino de las Sombras.
A premissa oficial situa a jornada de Miquella, a primeira chegada de Marika e o expurgo de Messmer no Reino das Sombras.
La guía oficial relaciona la derrota de Mohg, el capullo de Miquella y el paso del jugador al Reino de las Sombras; también exige derrotar a Radahn.
